Production asset: a transparent SQUARE full 4x4 sprite atlas with EXACTLY sixteen poses of one NEW original character for a top-down mobile brawler. Image 1 is a precise layout + art direction + animation reference from the game. Completely REPLACE the cactus and all its costume/weapon with the new model described below in ALL 16 slots. Preserve the 4 columns, 4 rows, transparent empty margins. Sculptural 3D arena brawler game, high-end chunky Supercell-like form language, strong silhouettes, angular rounded bevels, directional warm highlights, punchy materials, single large recognizable weapon. Three-quarter view from slightly above, facing RIGHT throughout. Each figure full-body with large eye-catching head and short expressive legs, same model proportions, palette and body size across cells. Keep feet at 91% of each cell height, standing pose height 76%, generous horizontal gutters and boundary padding so absolutely no overlap or touching. Not a poster, no branding, no words, no text, no floor or cast shadows, no platform or action lines outside the body. Genuine transparent background. Exactly 16 isolated full-body character drawings, with demonstrably different limb and weapon poses in action rows.
Row 1 four beats of an idle breathing loop, neutral stance / inhale raises shoulders and weapon / blink / exhale; feet planted. 
Row 2 anatomically believable 4-beat RUN cycle, all facing RIGHT with a fixed camera. 1 extremely clear contact with near leading boot outward to SCREEN RIGHT and far arm forward. 2 near boot steps UNDER hips and rear knee drives forward, body dips. 3 REVERSE STEP: near boot is stretched BACK far to SCREEN LEFT while the farther leg is now leading, near arm swings toward SCREEN RIGHT. 4 reverse passing position, near knee LIFTED forward, body's weight on far boot. Strong alternation. Never merely rotate or translate the same sprite.
Row 3 four specifically choreographed attack keyframes described below: windup -> full anticipation -> decisive contact/release -> recovery.
Row 4 first frame flinching/hunching and shielding face, next frame recoiling arched backward in hit stun, next frame body slumped kneeling in defeat, last frame fully toppled on the ground on their SIDE, dramatically shorter height than standing. All 16 frames clearly separated, no UI, no grids, no detached flashes or large particles.
NEW original hero: HUISHA, a nimble DESERT FENNEC FOX runner with very large pointy orange ears (dark tips and cream fluffy interiors), tangerine-orange fur, white muzzle, compact stocky body, bushy fox tail with a creamy tip, teal neckerchief streaming from the neck, IVORY-cream aviator jacket with rolled sleeves, tiny brown boots. Brand signature: one enormous rigid AQUA-TEAL crescent boomerang with gold edge and leather grip, about half body length. Oversized ears and weapon instantly legible at 64px. Row 3 attack: 1 pulls boomerang down near hip with knees bent, 2 rotates hips and cocks it high behind head, 3 whips arm forward to screen right with teal crescent just leaving hand STILL inside his own cell, 4 catches boomerang with opposite hand and recoils into stance. NO hats, guns, helmets or spikes.
